statuses.400: invalid_request: the request is malformed or missing required parameters
statuses.401: authentication_error: invalid API key or authentication credentials
statuses.403: permission_denied: the API key does not have permission to access the requested resource
statuses.404: not_found: the requested connector or resource does not exist
statuses.429: rate_limit_exceeded: too many requests in a given amount of time
statuses.500: server_error: an unexpected server error occurred

on_429: the response includes headers indicating the remaining quota and when it resets; the page names no header
